title: Local web dashboard under the KAD aesthetic directive, with the acquisition actions it can honestly drive
authority_required: operator instruction, 2026-09-12: a local dashboard showing owned items, completed missions, goals, prerequisites and everything else the backend holds; decision protocol answers: stdlib `serve` + buildless page, full control including inventory fetch; and: build the GUI and interface using the KAD aesthetic directive
scope: `kad-warframe serve`: a stdlib http.server dashboard bound to 127.0.0.1, no third-party dependency and no build step
a JSON API whose payloads come from the same view models the CLI's --json serves, so the web layer cannot compute a number the CLI would not
a buildless single-page frontend served from the package: overview, goals with their evidence and expiries, items, missions, quests, world state, and the actions panel

the KAD aesthetic directive applied as a projection: canonical tokens carried verbatim from ISA-KAD-AESTHETIC-001 as interface/tokens.css projects them, the foundation and component patterns reused, and every ISA testable claim brought into the project's own suite

actions: refresh the cached datasets in-process, and drive warframe-helper's own TUI in a tmux session for the inventory fetch and the database sync, capturing the screen and verifying every step before any key is sent

invariants carried into the UI: freshness visible and advising blocked when stale, UNKNOWN rendered as UNKNOWN, provenance and confidence on curated advice, expiries on time-bound advice, platinum-0 discipline
non_scope: reimplementing the memory scan or the mobile-API inventory fetch: that stays warframe-helper's code, which the dashboard drives rather than replaces
any binding other than 127.0.0.1, any authentication scheme, any CORS surface, any remote font, script or image
a JavaScript build step, a framework, or a second test stack
writing the player's account data anywhere new
driving a TUI step whose target screen has not been verified in the same run: the driver fails closed instead of pressing keys blind
inventing colours, radii, fonts or motion: the ISA forbids ad-hoc decorative values, and the conformance test enforces it
acceptance_criteria: `bin/kad-warframe serve` binds 127.0.0.1, serves the dashboard with no network access of its own beyond the sources the CLI already uses, and exits non-zero if the port is taken
every panel renders real data: goals with evidence, items, missions, quests, world state with expiries, freshness, needs-attention
the API's payloads equal the CLI's for the same fixture state, asserted in tests

actions are guarded: the inventory fetch refuses without a running game process, recorded consent, and the helper binary; every TUI navigation step is verified against the captured screen before a key is sent; the driver fails closed

the page is a faithful projection of the KAD aesthetic directive: canonical tokens only, no remote asset, no ambient animation loop, no audio API, skip link and visible focus rings, WCAG AAA contrast on primary text, and multi-redundant encoding of every state (colour + border + label + shape)
no third-party dependency is added and the page loads with no network access at all
the suite stays hermetic: no account data, no network, no real helper process
browser verification records each panel rendering real values, and the guards' failure modes
evidence records the commands, the ISA claims and how each was validated
notes: Supersedes WP-KAD-WARFRAME-002, which was released (claim ba54ea10) for the API integration and cannot be re-claimed under workctl's grammar. WP-003 (the official API source) is in REVIEW; this work consumes it.
